Title: As a user I can log in with valid credentials
Description: Login page accepts username + password and routes to dashboard
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid creds, when I submit, then I am redirected to /dashboard and my name appears in the sidebar

Title: As a user I see an error for invalid credentials
Description: Wrong password or unknown user shows a clear error
Acceptance Criteria: Given invalid creds, when I submit, then an inline error appears and I stay on /login

Title: As a user I can log out
Description: Logout clears my session and returns me to the landing page
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am logged in, when I click Sign Out, then I land on / and cannot access /dashboard

Title: As a user my session times out after 60 min idle
Description: Stale sessions should not allow access
Acceptance Criteria: After 60 min idle, accessing /dashboard redirects to /login

Title: As a user I can request a password reset
Acceptance Criteria: Given I click forgot password, then a request is added visible to admin

Title: As admin I can add a new user
Description: Admin → Users → Add User creates a Firestore user
Acceptance Criteria: Given admin role, when I submit the add-user form, then the new user appears in the list and can log in
Notes: Verifies the DEFAULT_ADMIN preservation bug stays fixed

Title: As admin I can edit a user
Acceptance Criteria: Given an existing user, when I change their name and save, then the change reflects everywhere (chat, meetings, logs)

Title: As admin I can delete a user
Description: Delete removes user and cascading references gracefully
Acceptance Criteria: Given a user with no critical references, when I delete, then they disappear; chats they wrote stay with sender info

Title: As admin I can assign modules to a user
Acceptance Criteria: Given a staff user, when I assign 'training' only, then they see only Training in the sidebar

Title: As master I have access to Finance routes
Acceptance Criteria: Given username = master, when I view sidebar, then Finance group is visible; for any other admin it is hidden

Title: As master I can view Activity Logs
Description: Activity Logs page lists all logActivity calls
Acceptance Criteria: Given master role, when I open /admin/logs, then I see action records from every test in this session

Title: As admin I can add a new candidate
Acceptance Criteria: Given the new-candidate form, when I submit valid data, then the candidate appears in the list with default status

Title: As admin I can edit a candidate
Description: Edit page updates all editable fields
Acceptance Criteria: Given an existing candidate, when I change name/email/etc and save, then the changes persist and are visible in the list

Title: As admin I can delete a candidate
Description: Delete with confirmation; cascade rules apply
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate, when I delete after confirming, then they are removed and dependent records handled gracefully

Title: As admin I can complete a candidate profile
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate, when I fill the profile and save, then the additional fields are stored and visible on re-open

Title: As admin I can send an agreement to a candidate
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate, when I send agreement, then agreementSentDate is set and a portal link is generated

Title: As candidate I can accept the agreement from the portal
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate clicks the portal link, when they accept, then agreementAcceptedDate is set on the candidate

Title: As admin I can transition candidate status
Description: Status changes follow the allowed CandidateStatus list
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate, when I change status from Training to Placed, then the new status appears and the change is logged

Title: As admin I can filter the candidate list
Description: Search and status filter narrow results
Acceptance Criteria: Given >5 candidates of different statuses, when I filter by Placed, then only Placed candidates show

Title: As admin I can upload a candidate resume
Description: Resume stored as base64 on the candidate doc
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate, when I upload a PDF, then it is saved and downloadable from the candidate page

Title: As admin I can add an enquiry
Acceptance Criteria: Given the enquiry form, when I submit, then the enquiry appears with status = Enquiry

Title: As admin I can update enquiry status
Description: Status flow Enquiry → Follow-Up → Joined / Not Interested
Acceptance Criteria: Given an enquiry, when I change status, then it persists and is reflected in the list

Title: As admin I can merge an enquiry into a new candidate
Description: Merge creates a Candidate populated from enquiry data
Acceptance Criteria: Given an enquiry in Joined status, when I merge, then a new candidate is created and the enquiry is marked merged with link

Title: As admin I can see new web leads
Description: WebLeads list shows submissions with unread badge
Acceptance Criteria: Given a web lead exists, when I open Web Enquiries, then the lead appears and the sidebar badge clears after read

Title: As admin I can create training modules and topics
Acceptance Criteria: Given the curriculum page, when I add a module then a topic under it, then both persist and are listed in order

Title: As admin I can record daily attendance
Acceptance Criteria: Given today and a list of candidates, when I mark Present/Absent and save, then attendance is stored and visible on next open

Title: As admin I can track candidate progress
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate with attendance + assignment data, when I open the monitor, then totals match the underlying logs

Title: As candidate I can view my training dashboard
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate logs in, when they view the dashboard, then they see their own logs only

Title: As admin I can schedule an interview
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate, when I create an interview with date/company/type, then it appears in the list and sidebar badge updates

Title: As admin I can update interview outcome
Acceptance Criteria: Given a scheduled interview, when I mark Selected, then the candidate record reflects the placement

Title: As admin I can manage interview questions
Acceptance Criteria: Given the question bank, when I add/edit/delete a question, then changes persist

Title: As candidate I can practise with the interview prep module
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate, when they run the prep module, then a session is recorded with score and feedback

Title: As master I can add an account
Acceptance Criteria: Given master role, when I add a Bank account, then it appears in the chart of accounts

Title: As master I can record a transaction
Acceptance Criteria: Given accounts/candidates exist, when I record a payment, then balances reflect and the txn is locked when applicable

Title: As master I can lock a transaction
Acceptance Criteria: Given a transaction, when I lock it, then edit/delete buttons are disabled and a log entry is created

Title: As master I can view account statements
Acceptance Criteria: Given an account with transactions, when I open its statement, then transactions appear in order with running balance

Title: As master I can run financial statements
Acceptance Criteria: Given some data, when I open financial statements, then totals reconcile to the underlying transactions

Title: As master I can run payroll
Description: Payroll page generates payroll for staff
Acceptance Criteria: Given staff users with salary accounts, when I run payroll for a month, then transactions are created against salary accounts

Title: As master I can export a multi-sheet financial report
Acceptance Criteria: Given data exists, when I export, then a valid .xls file downloads with the expected sheets

Title: As admin I see the Email page configured state
Acceptance Criteria: Given VITE_EMAIL_ENDPOINT/SECRET are unset, then I see 'not configured'; when set, the inbox loads

Title: As admin I can view my inbox
Acceptance Criteria: Given the bridge is configured, when I open Email, then the inbox loads and refreshes every 30 seconds

Title: As admin I can compose and send an email
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid To/Subject/Body, when I send, then the email is delivered and the modal closes

Title: As admin I can attach files to an outgoing email
Description: Files uploaded to Firebase Storage then attached server-side
Acceptance Criteria: Given a small image and PDF, when I send, then the recipient receives the attachments intact

Title: As admin I can reply to an inbox message
Acceptance Criteria: Given an inbox message, when I click Reply, then To/Subject/quoted body are pre-filled correctly

Title: As admin I can search the inbox
Acceptance Criteria: Given 5+ messages, when I type into search, then only matching rows remain visible

Title: As user I can start a DM with another user
Acceptance Criteria: Given another user exists, when I click + and select them, then a DM chat is created and selected

Title: As user I can send a text message
Acceptance Criteria: Given an active DM, when I send a message, then it appears in my thread and in the other user's thread in real time

Title: As user I can attach a file to a chat message
Acceptance Criteria: Given a DM and a small image, when I send, then the image renders inline; for a PDF, a link card renders

Title: As user I see unread badges
Description: Sidebar and chat list show counts
Acceptance Criteria: Given another user sent me messages while I was on another page, when I open Chat, then unread counts are correct

Title: As admin I can post in the Announcements channel
Acceptance Criteria: Given admin role, when I post in Announcements, then all users see the message; non-admin users see Read-only

Title: As user I can schedule a meeting
Acceptance Criteria: Given a future start/end and selected participants, when I save, then the meeting appears under Upcoming

Title: As user I can RSVP to a meeting
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am a participant, when I click Accept, then my badge updates everywhere and the organizer sees it live

Title: As organizer I can edit a meeting
Acceptance Criteria: Given a meeting I organized, when I change time/participants, then the meeting updates and participants see the changes

Title: As organizer I can cancel a meeting
Acceptance Criteria: Given a scheduled meeting, when I cancel, then status = cancelled and the Join button disappears

Title: As user I see Today badge in sidebar
Acceptance Criteria: Given meetings starting today, when I view the sidebar, then 'Today: N' badge appears next to Meetings

Title: As user I can schedule a meeting from a chat DM
Acceptance Criteria: Given a DM, when I click Schedule, then the meeting modal opens with the other user pre-selected

Title: As user I can start an instant call from a DM
Acceptance Criteria: Given a DM, when I click Call, then I am taken to /call and a CallInvitation is created

Title: As callee I see an incoming call overlay
Acceptance Criteria: Given another user calls me, when the invitation arrives, then I see a ring overlay with Accept/Decline buttons regardless of page

Title: As callee I can accept a call
Acceptance Criteria: Given a ringing call, when I click Accept, then I am taken to /call and meet the caller in the room

Title: As callee I can decline a call
Acceptance Criteria: Given a ringing call, when I click Decline, then the caller is notified and the ring stops

Title: As user I can join a scheduled meeting via video
Description: Join button on meeting card and detail modal
Acceptance Criteria: Given a scheduled meeting I am invited to, when I click Join, then I am taken to /call for that meeting's room

Title: As user I can leave a call
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am in a call, when I click Leave, then I return to where I came from and the invitation is marked ended

Title: Application is responsive on tablet width
Acceptance Criteria: Given a tablet viewport, when I navigate every top-level page, then nothing overflows and the sidebar collapses cleanly

Title: Application is responsive on phone width
Acceptance Criteria: Given a phone viewport (375px), when I open any page, then the mobile menu works and content is readable

Title: Cross-browser smoke passes on Tier 1
Acceptance Criteria: Given a build, when I run the smoke suite on Chrome and Edge, then all P0 cases pass

Title: Cross-browser smoke passes on Tier 2
Acceptance Criteria: Given a build, when I run the smoke suite on Firefox, then all P0 cases pass with no console errors

Title: Real-time sync works across two browsers
Acceptance Criteria: Given two browsers logged in as different users, when one user makes a change, then the other sees it within 5 seconds

Title: Bootstrap admin auto-restores when missing
Acceptance Criteria: Given an empty users collection, when I log in as the bootstrap admin and then add a user, then the bootstrap admin stays in Firestore
